simple.meaning: זִמְרָה (zimrâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a musical piece or song to be accompanied by an instrument.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 4 times across Psalms, Isaiah, Amos, beginning at Psalms 81:3. Its contexts include family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זִמְרָה (H2172).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: זִמְרָה (zimrâh) / H2172 is traced through Psalms 81:3, Psalms 98:5, Isaiah 51:3, Amos 5:23 as a generated source-based concept entry.
